task.description: WF-03 Step 2, hard gate on CODE-DESIGNER's design. Read lib/letflow/design/iss0911-start-instance-dialog-exact-lookup.md directly. Verify: (1) the fix genuinely calls definitionsApi.getActive keyed on the dialog's own typed value, not the page-level filtered list; (2) the race-guard reasoning (TanStack Query per-key cache/observer isolation preventing a stale response from landing in a superseded key) is actually correct -- read web/src/hooks/useDefinitions.ts and confirm the project's query client is genuinely configured this way (check for any global dedup/staleTime setting that could undermine the claim) rather than accepting the design's assertion at face value; (3) the 5-state version-field model (idle/loading/found/not_found/error) covers every real outcome with no gap; (4) definitionTypeahead's other uses are correctly identified as unaffected, verify this yourself by reading its other call sites in InstanceBoardPage.tsx; (5) no implementation code present -- signatures/shapes only. FAIL immediately on any check failure.
acceptance_criteria: the fix calls definitionsApi.getActive(name) (or an equivalent exact-match backend lookup) keyed on the dialog's own typed value, not the page-level filtered list
a race-guard against out-of-order async responses (rapid typing) is explicitly designed and independently verified correct, not just asserted
the version field's loading/not-found/found states are all specified with no gap
no implementation code in the design doc -- signatures/shapes and control-flow prose only

result.summary: All four ACs independently verified against source, not the design doc's own assertions. (1) definitionsApi.getActive(name) exists (web/src/api/definitions.ts:22-23, exact-match GET /api/v1/definitions/active/:name); design's useActiveDefinitionByName calls it keyed on the dialog's own debounced startDefinitionName, never definitionTypeahead. (2) Race-guard independently checked: web/src/main.tsx:19-26 sets a global QueryClient default (staleTime 30_000, retry 0) -- confirmed this does NOT undermine the per-key-isolation claim, since staleTime only governs refetch-on-mount/window-focus behavior for a given key's cache entry, not whether two distinct keys share a slot; the design's per-name queryKey (definitionKeys.active(trimmedName), already defined at web/src/api/useTenantScopedQueryKeys.ts:59) gives each distinct typed value its own cache entry/observer under TanStack Query v5.28 (web/package.json:29) semantics, which is the actual, correct basis for the race-guard, not the debounce (which the design itself correctly calls only a cosmetic request-volume reducer, section 4.2). No shared mutable slot exists for a stale response to land in. (3) Version-field state model (idle/loading/found/not_found/error) is exhaustive with no gap; idle vs loading vs not_found are kept distinct (blank input vs in-flight vs settled 404), matching the ORCH task's own framing that 5 states, not the AC's literal 3, is the correct exhaustive set. (4) definitionTypeahead's call sites independently re-grepped in web/src/pages/instances/InstanceBoardPage.tsx: line 85-88 declares it, line 141 (onResolveDefinition, page-level onBlur handler) and line 358 (datalist suggestion options) are the two sites the design claims remain untouched and legitimate -- confirmed both are unrelated to the dialog's resolution path; line 184 (onStartDefinitionNameChange) is the one site the design correctly identifies as the bug and replaces. No other call sites exist. (5) No implementation code in the design doc -- only type/function signatures (useActiveDefinitionByName, VersionLookupState, deriveVersionLookupState) and control-flow prose; no request bodies, no effect bodies, no JSX.
